PROJECTS
FormTrail - Recoverable Workflow Agent
Independent project | Jan 2026 - Sep 2026
Implemented a Python tool loop, SQLite checkpoints, typed action contracts, and a small JavaScript chat interface. The
prototype reads public job pages, analyzes descriptions, drafts documents, and prepares forms for review. It cannot submit
an application without a user review action.
Built Playwright tools for dependent selects, search inputs, uploads, and repeated education sections. Evaluated 96 synthetic
forms across five layouts, with 86% completing without intervention. Failures were logged by field and action; this result does
not establish compatibility with every real website.
Compared compact tool outputs and caching on a fixed 24-requirement workload. Reduced input tokens by 28% while
keeping evidence citations and explicit missing-data results. Tested interrupted sessions and stale browser references
separately from successful runs.
PermitLens - Document Intake Evaluation
Independent project | Mar 2025 - Jun 2025
Used Tesseract, pypdf, and Pydantic to extract structured fields from 300 synthetic permit forms and public sample
documents. Added confidence thresholds, format validation, and a manual review queue. Exact-field accuracy was 92% on
an 80-document holdout, with handwritten inputs remaining difficult.
Recorded parsing latency and common error categories. The project never handled patient records, deployed in a hospital,
or claimed HIPAA compliance. Domain-specific production use would require additional expertise and controls.
RouteBench - Mobility Analysis
Course project | Sep 2023 - Dec 2023
Processed 1.6 million public transit events using DuckDB and pandas, designed a star schema, and compared route-level
delay distributions. A scikit-learn gradient boosting baseline reached macro-F1 of 0.73 on a chronological holdout. A
Streamlit dashboard exposed filters, confidence limitations, and examples of seasonal drift.
